definition: In the proposition-2 projection, Participates x one marks x participating in the designated One. It is a bare directed attribution relation: the received-unity and nonidentity commitments are in the statement, not built into this definition. No spatial parts, efficient production, shared genus or Platonic Form classification follows.
note: The primary Lean locator names the existing shared Vocabulary.Participates field on the SAME Entity/Quality dictionary used by the Proclus projection. Its second argument one is interpreted as the designated One, not silently as a Platonic Form. TruthCore.Greek.Proclus.ElementsTheology.ParticipantUnityContrast is the separate statement constraining that field by received unity and nonidentity; it is not the relation's definition. Sharing an interface proves no historical or philosophical equivalence between Proclus and Plato. A fuller account of how participation occurs remains open.
